UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location 'grafana'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'data','provisioning' | Out-Null; $v = '{{GrafanaVersion}}'; if (-not $v) { $v = (Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing 'https://api.github.com/repos/grafana/grafana/releases/latest').tag_name }; $v = $v -replace '^v',''; if ($v -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(\+security-\d+)?$') { Write-Output ('Invalid Grafana version format specified: ' + $v); exit 1 }; if ((Test-Path 'server/bin/grafana.exe') -and (Test-Path 'server/.installed-version') -and ((Get-Content 'server/.installed-version' -Raw).Trim() -eq $v)) { Write-Output ('Grafana ' + $v + ' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; $u = ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing ('https://grafana.com/api/downloads/grafana/versions/' + $v.Replace('+','%2B'))).packages | Where-Object { $_.os -eq 'win' -and $_.arch -eq 'amd64' -and $_.url -match '\.(tar\.gz|zip)$' } | Select-Object -First 1).url; if (-not $u) { Write-Output ('No Windows build found for Grafana ' + $v + '. Aborting'); exit 1 }; $f = 'grafana-download' + [IO.Path]::GetExtension($u); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -OutFile $f $u } catch { Remove-Item $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'Download failed from dl.grafana.com. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'server') { Remove-Item 'server' -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'server' | Out-Null; & tar.exe -xf $f -C server --strip-components=1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'Extraction failed. Aborting'; exit 1 }; Remove-Item $f -Force; Set-Content -Path 'server/.installed-version' -Value $v; Get-ChildItem 'server/conf/provisioning' -Directory | ForEach-Object { if (-not (Test-Path ('provisioning/' + $_.Name))) { Copy-Item $_.FullName ('provisioning/' + $_.Name) -Recurse } }; Write-Output ('Grafana ' + $v + ' installed')"

-c "V=\"{{GrafanaVersion}}\"; A=\"amd64\"; cd grafana || exit 1; mkdir -p data provisioning; if [[ -z \"$V\" ]]; then V=$(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/grafana/grafana/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name); fi; V=\"${V#v}\"; if [[ ! \"$V\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\+security-[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid Grafana version format specified: $V\"; exit 1; fi; if [[ -x server/bin/grafana && \"$(cat server/.installed-version 2>/dev/null)\" == \"$V\" ]]; then echo \"Grafana $V already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0; fi; U=$(wget -qO- \"https://grafana.com/api/downloads/grafana/versions/${V/+/%2B}\" | jq -r --arg a \"$A\" '[.packages[] | select(.os == \"linux\" and .arch == $a and (.url | endswith(\".tar.gz\"))) | .url][0] // empty'); if [[ -z \"$U\" ]]; then echo \"No Linux $A build found for Grafana $V. Aborting\"; exit 1; fi; rm -f grafana.tar.gz; wget -qO grafana.tar.gz \"$U\" || { rm -f grafana.tar.gz; echo \"Download failed from dl.grafana.com. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf server && mkdir -p server && tar -xzf grafana.tar.gz -C server --strip-components=1 && rm -f grafana.tar.gz && chmod +x server/bin/* && echo \"$V\" > server/.installed-version || { echo \"Extraction failed. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; for d in server/conf/provisioning/*/; do n=$(basename \"$d\"); [[ -d \"provisioning/$n\" ]] || cp -r \"$d\" \"provisioning/$n\"; done; echo \"Grafana $V installed\""
